thread:
tanya: quick flag - our rerank jobs started failing in staging after swapping to the new batch helper. getting dim mismatch.

tanya: repro (node):
```js
const out = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'embed-xl', input: myBatch});
console.log(out.data[0].embedding?.length || '(bytes) ' + out.data[0].embedding_bytes.length);
// -> 4095 bytes / 1365 floats or 4095 bytes not divisible by 4
```

matt: that sounds like the "embedding_bytes" path. if bytes % 4 != 0 unpack will drop the last float. which sdk/runtime?

tanya: node SDK 1.2.0, running in our k8s job. logged len(embedding_bytes) = 16379 => 16379 % 4 = 3. rerank rejects with expected_dim=4096 got=4095.

matt: likely a bug in the helper that slices ArrayBuffer incorrectly for final chunk. workaround: pad before unpack: `if (b.length%4) b = Buffer.concat([b, Buffer.alloc(4 - (b.length%4))])`. we'll push fix to 1.2.1.

infra-bot: Created INF-5201: "embed batch helper: arraybuffer slice loses padding byte -> rerank dim mismatch" assigned to @matt.

tanya: confirmed local patch fixes rerank. note for folks: check embedding vs embedding_bytes, and assert dimension before calling rerank.

matt: action items: 1) patch helper to use ArrayBuffer.byteLength consistently + add unit for odd-byte cases, 2) server to return explicit diagnostic JSON on dim mismatch, 3) SDK changelog entry.

devex-bot: Noted. Closing thread for now; reopen if regression appears. :thumbsup:
